sections.title: Community shops & makers
sections.summary: Queer, disabled, and BIPOC-led shops we love supporting with every seasonal hub.

partners.name: Ember & Loom Apothecary
partners.description: Small-batch ritual kits, hand-dyed altar cloths, and refill programs that keep release rituals low-waste.

partners.name: Luna Larder Pantry
partners.description: Herbal teas, spice blends, and grounding snacks sourced from cooperative farms.
partners.notes: 10% of every sale funds the Cozy Nights mutual aid pot.

sections.title: Mutual aid & funds
sections.summary: Sliding-scale circles and emergency funds we boost each season.

partners.name: Cozy Nights Mutual Aid Fund
partners.description: Provides hotel rooms, hot meals, and healing stipends for trans femmes in the Great Lakes region.
partners.notes: Needs monthly sustainers to cover winter lodging.

partners.name: Care Doula Collective
partners.description: Volunteer network offering rides, meal trains, and respite care for organizers navigating burnout.
partners.notes: Accepting both funds and volunteer hours; DM for onboarding.

sections.title: Practitioners & partner services
sections.summary: Collaborators offering workshops, breathwork, and planning sessions for our hubs.

partners.name: Gentle Horizon Breathwork
partners.description: Slow, consent-based breathwork sessions designed to downshift nervous systems before ritual work.
partners.notes: Partnered with WitchClick for seasonal calm circles.

affiliateHighlights.name: Moonlit Bath Release Bundle
affiliateHighlights.description: Sea salt soak, candle trio, and printable release script curated with Ember & Loom.
affiliateHighlights.ethicalNote: Certified cruelty-free ingredients with local sourcing.

affiliateHighlights.name: Micro Focus Ritual Deck
affiliateHighlights.description: 54-card deck with Micah's somatic prompts, stretch timers, and accountability check-ins.
affiliateHighlights.ethicalNote: Profits fund free ADHD-friendly coworking seats.

affiliateHighlights.name: Calm Breathing Orb
affiliateHighlights.description: Hand-thrown ceramic orb that guides paced breathing with gentle light pulses.
affiliateHighlights.ethicalNote: 10% of proceeds donated to trauma-informed therapy scholarships.
